break_glass_requires: explicit human emergency authorization + immediate source projection + protected-main reconciliation
deployment_scope: Supabase GitHub Integration deploys only Edge Functions declared in supabase/config.toml. Production authority scopes config.toml/_shared changes to that declared set and rejects any directly changed function that is undeclared.
readback: current protected-main first uses an exact-SHA successful Supabase GitHub App production check when present; otherwise it resolves a bounded recent successful production deployment anchor whose supabase/config.toml plus selected Edge Function source trees are byte-equivalent to the current protected-main SHA. The anchor check is observed twice. GitHub Actions then uses a scoped read-only SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN with `supabase functions download --use-api` and byte-compares the complete provider file set against current protected main.
terminal_truth: protected merge -> Supabase GitHub Integration production deployment anchor -> proof current protected-main selected runtime is source-equivalent to that successful anchor -> scoped PAT server-side source readback via --use-api -> byte-for-byte provider-source parity -> no newer Supabase runtime drift
secret_requirement: GitHub production environment secret SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN; scoped to the production project with Edge Functions Read only when scoped PATs are available; never used for deployment
rationale: preserve Supabase GitHub Integration as the sole production writer while allowing safe manual/current-main attestation after unrelated main commits that correctly receive only a skipped Supabase preview check
readback_token_policy: READ_ONLY_EDGE_FUNCTIONS_READ; SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN MUST NOT AUTHORIZE OR EXECUTE PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
